title: Meeting Sal Again

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: Hey amigo, buddypal. So happy to see ya.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey amigo, buddypal. So happy to see ya.

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: Ey, sit here and talk to me awhile. Let's shoot the cheese, like old times.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ey, sit here and talk to me awhile. Let's shoot the cheese, like old times.

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: Ooh, remember that time you bought me those... onions. And all the other times... I always knew you were a real pal. True choux.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ooh, remember that time you bought me those... onions. And all the other times... I always knew you were a real pal. True choux.

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: They fired me from Fusion Point! Me! Sal Magundi! Winner of best egg dish three years in a row.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They fired me from Fusion Point! Me! Sal Magundi! Winner of best egg dish three years in a row.

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: And the worst part? My own arms STABBED ME IN THE BACK. They refused to come with me! Bastards!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And the worst part? My own arms STABBED ME IN THE BACK. They refused to come with me! Bastards!

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: They upgraded their firmware and deleted me as a user when I was taking a power nap. Now they're chopping away for some weedy sous-hack fresh out of culinary programming.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They upgraded their firmware and deleted me as a user when I was taking a power nap. Now they're chopping away for some weedy sous-hack fresh out of culinary programming.
Never trust a MeanCuisine.

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: Some friend you are. Kick a droid when he's down. Corpster.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Some friend you are. Kick a droid when he's down. Corpster.

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: But what else can I do? I'm a chef, built and trained.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But what else can I do? I'm a chef, built and trained.

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: Hahaha. Thassa good one. Oh wait, you're serious?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hahaha. Thassa good one. Oh wait, you're serious?

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: Listen, don't take this the wrong way but I'm a top tier chef d'cuisine, not some HOVA-stop saucier.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Listen, don't take this the wrong way but I'm a top tier chef d'cuisine, not some HOVA-stop saucier.

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: Unless you gotta good rep, Sal ain't interested.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Unless you gotta good rep, Sal ain't interested.

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: You gotta have a review score of I dunno, 3 at least. At LEAST.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You gotta have a review score of I dunno, 3 at least. At LEAST.

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: Eh, I'll believe it when I see it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh, I'll believe it when I see it.
No time like the croissant.
OUI CHEF!

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: As a matter of fact I do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As a matter of fact I do.

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: Unless you gotta good rep, Sal ain't interested, anyway.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Unless you gotta good rep, Sal ain't interested, anyway.
Err... you too?
Don't you mean "shoot the breeze?"
There were old times?
Are you ok?
Right. I have to go...
I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's a dog eat dog world.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a dog eat dog world.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's a dog eat dog world.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's a dog eat dog world.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your arms can do that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Mmmhmm. Well, I've got to go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mmmhmm. Well, I've got to go.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Mmmhmm. Well, I've got to go.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Mmmhmm. Well, I've got to go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...Bastards!
You don't need them!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You could come work for me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You could come work for me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You could come work for me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You could come work for me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, why not?
What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What, like you have any other offers?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What, like you have any other offers?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What, like you have any other offers?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What, like you have any other offers?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What kind of rep?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Say no more. When can you start?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Say no more. When can you start?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Say no more. When can you start?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Say no more. When can you start?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Challenge accepted.
Let's say tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sorry. What would it take for you to come and work for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry. What would it take for you to come and work for me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm sorry. What would it take for you to come and work for me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm sorry. What would it take for you to come and work for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Go bother someone else then.
Nah, just joking.

limitations: Static asset graph, not a simulation of game code or save state.
Conditions are preserved, not evaluated; route totals are conditional on them.
Only literal assignments and increments are interpreted; other scripts stay unparsed.
Demeanor is an NPC expression, not a relationship-meter change.
Friend/Business icon meanings come from gameplay; Enemy's UI label is unconfirmed.
Routes stop at this conversation's exit; external dialogue gates are shown separately.
